_comment: Central site configuration. Consumed by scripts/build.mjs.
Paths are relative to the deployed site root. 'base_path' is the
subdirectory the site is served from on GitHub Pages.
If you later serve the site from a root domain, set base_path to '/' and
rebuild - every generated URL is derived from this one value.
'description' supports {placeholders} that are filled in from the real
{variants}, {inversions}. This keeps the copy honest automatically.
name: eSIM Price Truth
title: Cheapest eSIM Prices in 20 Currencies — eSIM Price Truth (2026)
tagline: Find the cheapest eSIM for your trip, in the currency that costs you least.
description: Compare eSIM prices across {currencies} currencies and {destinations} destinations, find the plan that really costs least, and see which checkout currency saves you money. {prices} prices checked.
author: Youssef Benatti

_comment: User-facing identity. 'name' is the brand, 'tagline' the one-line
promise, and 'hero_*' the copy used at the top of the homepage.
Everything here is written for the traveller, not for the operator.

brand.hero_headline: Find the cheapest eSIM for your trip — in 20 currencies
brand.hero_sub: Pick your destination and trip length. We check every price, show the currency that costs you least, and flag the plans that are priced backwards.
